text:
Olivia (People Ops): FYI: Harper arriving ~3:20pm with a large framed print (fragile, wide) + 3 small envelopes of prints. Harper requires wheelchair access and prefers a spot near the main entrance ramp. Also, a package was dropped off earlier for 'Reception A' but our building uses 'Reception'. Can someone prep manual badge flow and clear a pathway near the ramp? Thanks! :wheelchair::art:

Sam (Front Desk): Copy that. Kiosk is timing out for photos on my screen. I can do manual badges and hold the framed print at the desk until Harper arrives. Where should we put the envelopes?

MailBot: Delivery alert: UPS delivered at 9:12am labeled "Reception A". Status: left at front desk.

Diego: I moved the UPS box to Mailroom Shelf 1 and labeled it "misdelivered - Reception A". I'll route to Logistics pickup.

Olivia (People Ops): Perfect. Please tag it "hold until logistics". For Harper, reserve the ramp-side bench and remove the low planter for clearance. Also bring a folding stool for the courier to sign on if needed.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (kiosk down):
```
# manual badge quick flow
/usr/bin/camshot --out /tmp/harper.jpg --device frontdesk
/usr/local/bin/create_badge --name "Harper" --role Visitor --photo /tmp/harper.jpg --access "ramp,main-floor" --ttl 4h > /tmp/harper_badge.pdf
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/harper_badge.pdf
```
I'll also create a guest_access token limited to main-floor.

BadgePrinterBot: NOTICE - ribbon low at 3:15pm, switching to draft mode.

Sam (Front Desk): Draft badge printed at 3:17pm. Lanyards low; issuing clip badge. Moving low planter now to clear ramp. :white_check_mark:

Diego: UPS box routed to Mailroom Shelf 1 with note. Left sticker: "Reception A - misdelivered - notify logistics".

Harper (Visitor): Running a couple minutes late, thanks so much for holding the print. Ramp access is great. The framed piece has a spare hanging bracket taped to the back labeled "hang-north" in case facilities need it.

Olivia (People Ops): Thanks Harper 9Ive added the "hang-north" note to the install checklist and pinged Facilities. Seating poll for companion (near ramp bench) - bench :bench: or folding chair by planter :chair:? Reply with emoji.

Diego: :bench: bench is clear and safer for mobility. Set a small side table for water.

Sam (Front Desk): Harper arrived 3:19pm, ID verified, badge issued (clip). Envelopes stored in Mailroom Shelf 2; framed print at desk, helper on hand to carry to the ramp bench. Companion seated at ramp bench, water placed. UPS misdeliver queued for Logistics. All good.

Harper (Visitor): Thank you everyone! Left a small note inside the frame with a spare screw for hanging labeled "install-screw". Really appreciate the accessibility help.

Olivia (People Ops): Added "spare screw in frame" to the notes and pinged Facilities/Install channel. Closing thread 9huge thanks :raised_hands:
